Subject: Update on your application for the Marketing position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for applying for the Marketing position at our company. We appreciate the time and effort you invested in your application and the opportunity to learn about your background.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely aligns with our current needs. Please know that this decision was not a reflection of your skills or potential, as we were impressed by your qualifications. However, we are looking for a specific fit for this particular role.

We wish you the very best in your job search and future professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
